purpose: Single-factor audit of null-frame recurrent updates, not accuracy selection
inputs: Artificial long missing prefixes/gaps, mixed batches and frame-ID gaps
control: Existing H5 update_all null-frame GRU behavior with model seed19/hand seed29/noise97/K8/8Euler
candidate: Freeze carried GRU hidden only when original encoder frame_observed is false; current image/2D availability remains distinct from strict shape admission. Missing output global feature is last carried hidden (zero before first observation), not new evidence. No time encoding added.
unique_variable: Missing-frame recurrent transition; original encoder/GRU parameters, local conditions, hand branch, shape pooling/head, generator/noise, translations head and publication rules unchanged. Translation/global features/shape may differ downstream as a consequence, not additional head modifications.
implementation: Scoped eager original GRU forward-output hook replays original same GRU per time step and selects hidden; original batched GRU invocation still runs then its result is replaced. No author or core source edits; no new parameters. Extra diagnostic compute and shared-module hook concurrency/compilation limitation explicitly retained.
elapsed_time_policy: Freeze has no learned/explicit elapsed-time signal. Frame IDs remain validation metadata; gaps1/8/64 and sparse IDs must demonstrate compressed-observation equivalence and lack of duration response. This is a limitation, not temporal correctness or deployment approval.
checks: Disabled policy matches H5 saved controls
All observed equivalence within2e-5, no added parameters or state_dict updates
Full360 source fields/rejected states/native inputs preserved; unavailable publication remains NaN
Frame-by-frame and chunks11/64 match policy within2e-5
Hidden exactly invariant during all-missing and no state mutation, mixed row independence
Long missing recovery equals same original GRU update from pre-gap state; missing duration insensitivity reported
Strict shape admission remains original; observation presence alone not shape admission
Exception removes hook; original encoder unchanged after scoped invocation
Gradients from recovered output through observed inputs/history finite, masked input gradient0; no optimizer or update
True SMPL-H ready outputs, independent saved parameter reconstruction
success: Contract and causal state checks pass; full missing reasons retained; no accuracy preference inferred
stop: Keep actual failures/versioned outputs. Do not relax2e-5, fill gaps, train/load checkpoints, add time features or change shape pooling.
boundary: Untrained structure/state diagnostics only; freeze ignores elapsed time and cannot be called a better motion model without independent training/evaluation
